why is it called emptyRoot when the generated class name is empty? Could you in parallel also open a PR on specs so we can discuss final DOM before it leaves experimental?
I think we maybe should instead @ts-ignore there, since the change there is only while it's experimental
is this `any` on v3 or an error?
do we have an error message if any of these parameters are missed, or do we rely on the engine erroring?

```suggestion
  queryLanguages: Array<'en'>;
```

maybe this is good for the InstantSearch widget?

what about queryID and __escaped?
